Paint Shop Construction: Simulation Supports Projects from Planning Through Commissioning

b+m surface systems GmbH builds paint shops and automated application systems for virtually any painting task. This medium-sized, internationally active company primarily serves the automotive and supplier industries. Manufacturers of commercial vehicles, agricultural machinery, and rail vehicles also use b+m systems for painting.
Initial Situation: Increasing Complexity and Time Pressure

Customers’ processes are becoming more complex, while project timelines are shrinking. As a result, b+m decided to invest in the digital factory. The goal: higher-quality planning and lower follow-up costs.

Together with SimPlan, b+m evaluated and implemented the Plant Simulation program. The goal was to gradually apply event-driven simulation across the entire value chain: from the initial planning steps through detailed planning and commissioning to advising the end customer during ongoing operations.
